Parveer Kumar And 57 Others vs Union Of India And 3 Others
on 21 July, 2023
Author: Siddhartha Varma

Bench: Siddhartha Varma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:145685-Db
Court No. - 3
Case :- Writ - C No. - 19320 of 2023
Petitioner :- Parveer Kumar And 57 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Respondent :- Union Of India And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Vijay Kumar,Rajive Kumar

Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,C.S.C.,Sabhajeet Singh
Hon'ble Siddhartha Varma,J.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned counsel for the respondents and learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondents.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners states that the petitioners in the instant petition also ought to be given the benefits which flow out of Section 31 of the Right To Fair Compensation and Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as the 'Act, 2013').

entities.text: Right To Fair Compensation and Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners states that the benefits which flow out of the Act, 2013 have been made applicable to the acquisitions which have been made under the National Highways Act, 1956.

In this regard, learned counsel has relied upon the order of this Court Parveer Kumar And 57 Others vs Union Of India And 3 Others on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181731960/
1 dated 21.02.2023 passed in Writ-C No.21601 of 2022.

entities.text: Parveer Kumar And 57 Others vs Union Of India And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Under such circumstances, the instant writ petition is disposed of in terms of the order passed in Writ-C No.21601 of 2022.

A decision in the instant case shall also be taken in accordance with the law as has been laid down in Writ-C No.21601 of 2022 within a period of three months from the date of presentation of a certified copy of this order.
